subject: Coordination: security exhibit, SOC 2 evidence & pen-test scheduling (MSA/Order Form)
messages:
From: Anita Patel <anita.patel@atlashealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit + audit logistics for Redwood MSA

Hi Evelyn —

As we carve the MSA and order form for our pilot, Legal at Atlas needs to confirm a few items related to the security exhibit and audit rights so we can close procurement next week. High level asks: 

- A copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II (or SOC report summary) and the date range it covers.
- Clarification on pen-test language: will you accept a scoped pen test initiated by Atlas with an approved third-party vendor, or do you require Redwood to run the engagement?
- Audit rights: we need to understand the cadence (annual vs. ad-hoc), notice period, and any limitations on data/environment access (prod vs. non-prod).
- Evidence cadence: for procurement, we typically ask for a 2-week evidence window (document uploads + 1 point of contact).

Can you share Redwood's security exhibit draft and recommended language for order form redlines? If possible, we would like to schedule a short call (30 min) early next week to align on scope and timing — Atlas is targeting a pen-test window in Jan (10–14) if that works.

I'm attaching our questionnaire and a list of controls Atlas will prioritize.

Thanks,
Anita Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager
Atlas Health
(Attachment: Atlas-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit logistics for Redwood MSA

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (Legal) and Ben (Product Security) so we can pull the right artifacts and propose concrete language. Quick responses below and then we'll propose a short MPP (mutual action plan).

- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for the latest cycle (Q2 2026) under NDA/secure link. I'll attach a redacted PDF for your review.
- Pen test: Redwood's preference is to run a vendor-managed engagement to ensure consistency, but we can support Atlas-initiated tests under a scoped SOW and with a signed rules-of-engagement doc. We typically ask for 30 days' notice for vendor onboarding; for Jan 10–14 that should be workable if we confirm by Dec 10.
- Audit rights: our standard security exhibit limits audit to annual third-party assessments or a single vendor-provided SOC report; ad-hoc audits are possible with reasonable cause and 30 days' notice. We propose 5 business days to provide requested evidence unless otherwise scoped.
- Evidence cadence: we can agree to an initial 2-week evidence window and then monthly snapshots for the pilot period.

Attached: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx (draft), SOC2_Type2_Report_Q2_2026.pdf (redacted). Karthik — can you review the exhibit draft and highlight any MSA/order form redlines we should expect? Ben — please confirm pen-test SOW requirements and the minimum environment we can grant (non-prod with sanitized data, limited IAM, and an escorted prod-only read scope if absolutely necessary).

If it helps, I can send a short mutual action plan with milestones: artifacts due, legal redlines due, pen-test confirmation, and sign-off. Proposed call windows: Mon 11/30 10–11am PT or Tue 12/1 9–10am PT.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx, SOC2_Type2_Report_Q2_2026.pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anita Patel <anita.patel@atlashealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit logistics for Redwood MSA

Hi Anita / team —

Thanks for raising this. I've reviewed the draft exhibit Evelyn shared and propose the following redline-level items we expect to land in the MSA/order form:

1) Audit scope and frequency:
   - Limit on-site or direct auditor access to annual audits or where mutually agreed (Operational requirement: Atlas to provide 30 days' written notice).
   - For ad-hoc audits, require demonstrable cause and negotiation of scope and timelines.

2) Evidence delivery and timing:
   - Redwood will provide requested evidence within 5 business days of a formal, scoped request (evidence types enumerated in the exhibit).
   - For broader document production, require a mutually-agreed schedule; we propose weekly bundles over a 2-week initial window for pilot onboarding.

3) Pen test language and rules-of-engagement (ROE):
   - We can accept customer-initiated tests if Atlas: (a) uses an approved vendor, (b) signs our ROE, and (c) limits scope to non-production or agreed endpoints.
   - For production-facing tests, Redwood prefers to manage or co-manage with our security team present; otherwise, tests are limited to read-only assessment and must exclude customer data.

4) Audit rights subrogation / confidentiality:
   - Auditor access will be limited to information necessary to validate controls; any sensitive Redwood IP or tooling is excluded.

I attached a short redline file with suggested clause wording and a draft PenTest_SOW that enumerates the environment, allowed techniques, and blackout periods. If Atlas is comfortable with this approach we can produce a final exhibit that maps directly into the order form (so countersign can be fast).

Please confirm: (a) whether Atlas will run its own vendor or use Redwood's vendor for the Jan test window; (b) whether Atlas accepts a 5-business-day evidence SLA and 30-day notice for tests.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: proposed_audit_clause_redlines.docx, PenTest_SOW_Redwood.pdf)
From: Anita Patel <anita.patel@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlashealth.com>, Atlas Health Legal <legal@atlashealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit logistics for Redwood MSA

Evelyn / Karthik — appreciate the fast turnaround and the draft exhibit. Atlas legal reviewed internally and is generally aligned with Redwood's approach, subject to the following: 

- Atlas can use an approved third-party vendor, but we prefer to run the engagement and will sign a ROE. We accept the limitation to non-prod for the pilot; if production testing is needed later, we will coordinate a co-managed approach.
- Jan 10–14 pen test window works for Atlas. We will aim to confirm the vendor and provide 30 days notice (confirm by Dec 10).
- 5 business days for routine evidence is acceptable; Atlas requests that critical control evidence (encryption, access logs) be prioritized within the first 48 hours when possible.
- For the SOC2 report: thank you — the redacted PDF is fine. We will treat it as confidential.

Next steps: 
1) Redwood to send a final security exhibit with the agreed redlines mapped into the MSA/order form (we will review and return countersign pages).
2) Karthik to share the final ROE and PenTest_SOW; Atlas to share vendor details by Dec 10.
3) Schedule the alignment call — Tue 12/1 9am PT works for our team.

Please send a DocuSign-ready order form once the exhibit is finalized; procurement will attach it to the PO.

Best,
Anita Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager
Atlas Health
(Attachment: Atlas_Internal_Control_Priorities.xlsx)
